runs.objective: Click 'Add to Cart', then in the cart click 'Proceed to Checkout', and verify that 'Secure Checkout' is displayed.
runs.summary:
The store accepts the add-to-cart action but leaves checkout unavailable, preventing a customer with an item in the cart from continuing.
Fix the cart state after a successful add so that Proceed to Checkout is enabled when the cart contains the added item, then verify it opens Secure Checkout.
evidence: error_ui_text: The cart's Proceed to Checkout button is disabled and displays a defect error.
evidence: objective_contradiction: POST http://127.0.0.1:3005/cart/add -> 303
evidence: objective_contradiction: GET http://127.0.0.1:3005/cart -> 200
